title: Bright 4BR Townhome in The Nations · Sleeps 12
description:
Bring the whole crew to this bright, modern four-bedroom townhome tucked into The Nations — West Nashville's buzziest neighborhood. Five queen beds and a single sleep up to twelve, with an open living-and-kitchen space made for lingering and a private patio out back for morning coffee or an easy evening wind-down. You're walking distance to craft breweries, coffee shops, and street art, with Broadway and downtown just fifteen minutes away. Music City, made simple.

The space
Step inside to a bright, open-concept main level where the living room and kitchen flow together into the natural heart of the home. Sink into plush seating, cue up a show or a playlist on the big Smart TV, and let everyone spread out after a day of exploring.

Love to cook? The fully equipped kitchen has what you need for a real meal — stainless steel appliances, generous counter space, cookware, dishes, and a coffee maker for big group breakfasts before the honky-tonks or a late-night snack after the show.

Four comfortable bedrooms are outfitted with five queen beds and a single, comfortably sleeping up to twelve. With three bathrooms, no one's waiting around on those big nights out, and fresh linens and room to unwind make it easy to settle in.

Out back, a private patio gives you a quiet spot for morning coffee, a cold drink at golden hour, or a place for a four-legged travel companion to stretch their legs.

Rounding it all out: an in-unit washer and dryer, central heating and air, fast Wi-Fi, and keyless entry for a seamless arrival. Parking is stress-free too — a secure lot behind an electronic, resident-only gate with room for two vehicles.

Guest access
You'll have exclusive access to all the amenities shown in this listing during your stay.
